metadata.description: FORSVN turns your coding agent into a full product team — composable skills across research, marketing, product, and process. One front door (/forsvn) routes any request; every skill writes artifacts the next one reads, so context compounds. Single install from github.com/hungv47/meta-skills.

plugins.name: forsvn
plugins.description: Composable skills across research, marketing, product, and meta (process). /forsvn is the single front door — describe what you want in plain English and it routes you. Renamed from forsvn-skills; still distributed from hungv47/meta-skills for URL continuity.

plugins.name: forsvn-preview
plugins.description: The collaborative review surface for FORSVN. Renders any Markdown artifact into a themed, on-brand HTML preview and captures your approve / deny / request-changes decision back into the artifact — the agent drafts, you decide. Install alongside forsvn for the full review UX; skills alone emit plain Markdown. Ships a /forsvn-preview:review command to list pending artifacts and serve one for a human decision.
